title: Common Search Widget Config Schema
description: Configuration for the common search widget, defining search criteria per context

context.description: The context this search configuration applies to

translationKey.description: i18n key for the tab/section label

requiredPrivileges.description: Privileges required to access this search context

locationAware.description: Location scope applied when executing searches in this context

url.description: API endpoint URL for search results

criteria.description: Search criteria available in this context

resultFields.description: Defines the columns shown in the results table after a successful search

actions.description: Actions available in this context. Optional at the context level, but required when any resultField references an action key. Each action key must be unique within the context.

translationKey.description: i18n key for the column header

expression.description: JSONata expression evaluated against each result item to extract the column value

enableSort.description: When true, the column header is clickable to sort results client-side

filterType.description: When present, a filter control appears for this column

action.description: Key of an action defined in the context's actions array. When the referenced action has type navigate, the cell renders as a link. If the user holds none of the action's required privileges, the cell renders as plain text. Referencing a key not present in the actions array is a config error and blocks the widget.

transform.description: Name of a transform applied to the extracted value before display

default.description: Whether this criterion is shown by default in the UI

translationKey.description: i18n key for the criterion label

key.description: Field identifier used when constructing the search query

keyType.description: UUID or type qualifier for polymorphic fields such as identifier or personAttribute

regex.description: Optional regular expression. When provided, the value is validated against this pattern on search submission.

rangeAllowed.description: When true, UI renders two inputs (From and To), each with its own value and comparator
When true, UI renders two inputs (From and To), each with its own value and comparator

source.description: Identifies the lookup source (e.g. appointmentService, concept)

prefetch.description: Whether to load all options upfront rather than on user input

valueSet.description: UUID of the concept value set to restrict lookup results

key.description: Unique identifier for this action within the context. Referenced by resultField entries via their action field.

type.description: Renders the column cell as a link navigating to navigationURL.

navigationURL.description: URL template for navigation. Placeholders use {expression} syntax where the content must be a valid JSONata expression evaluated against the result row. For example, {uuid} resolves the uuid field; {patient.uuid} resolves a nested field.

requiredPrivileges.description: Privileges required to activate this action. Any one suffices. An empty array makes the action available to all users.
